description: This file is a JUnit test class for the AdvancedPaymentAllocationsValidator in the Apache Fineract project. It includes test cases for validating payment allocation rules and strategies related to loan product payment allocation configurations.

classes.name: AdvancedPaymentAllocationsValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for AdvancedPaymentAllocationsValidator, testing validation logic for various payment allocation rules and strategies in loan product configuration.

methods.name: testPaymentAllocationsHasNoError
methods.description: Tests that valid payment allocation rules pass without errors.

methods.name: testPaymentAllocationsValidationThrowsErrorWhenLessElement
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when the number of allocation rules is less than expected.

methods.name: testPaymentAllocationsValidationThrowsErrorWhenWithDuplicate
methods.description: Checks that duplicates in allocation rules trigger validation errors.

methods.name: testPaymentAllocationsValidationThrowsErrorWhenOrderIsNotInRange
methods.description: Validates that allocation rule orders outside the valid range trigger errors.

methods.name: testValidateNoError
methods.description: Tests that correct allocation rules pass validation.

methods.name: testValidateEmptyRuleList
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if no payment allocation rules are provided when strategy is selected.

methods.name: testValidateMissingList
methods.description: Checks that null input for validation triggers appropriate validation exception.

methods.name: testValidatePaymentAllocationThrowsErrorWhenNoDefault
methods.description: Verifies that absence of DEFAULT transaction type triggers validation error.

methods.name: testValidateThrowsErrorWhenDuplicate
methods.description: Ensures duplicate transaction types in rules result in validation errors.

methods.name: testValidateThrowsErrorWhenPaymentAllocationProvidedWithOtherStrategy
methods.description: Validates that payment allocation rules are not provided when a different strategy is selected.

methods.name: testValidateThrowsErrorWhenFutureInstallmentIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that missing future installment allocation rules trigger errors.

methods.name: testValidateThrowsErrorWhenTransactionTypeEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that empty or null transaction types trigger validation errors.

methods.name: checkGroupingOfAllocationRulesGoodOrder
methods.description: Tests correct grouping of allocation rules in proper order.

methods.name: checkGroupingOfAllocationRulesWrongOrder
methods.description: Tests detection of invalid grouping when allocation rules are in the wrong order.

methods.name: assertPlatformValidationException
methods.description: Helper method to assert validation exceptions with specific messages and codes.

methods.name: createLoanProductAllocationRule1
methods.description: Creates a sample LoanProductPaymentAllocationRule with default transaction type.

methods.name: createLoanProductAllocationRule2
methods.description: Creates a sample LoanProductPaymentAllocationRule with repayment transaction type.

methods.name: createLoanProductAllocationRule3
methods.description: Creates an allocation rule with swapped allocation types to test order violations.

methods.name: createLoanProductAllocationRule4
methods.description: Creates an allocation rule with a specific swap pattern to test grouping logic.

methods.name: createPaymentAllocationTypeList
methods.description: Generates a list of pairs mapping integers to PaymentAllocationType enums for testing.
